description: Get a recap of a finished Fun Friday room: every game played and who won it, the overall table across those games, the top of the team's all-time leaderboard, the user's next planned game if there is one, and a link to the full results page. The text is ready to paste into Slack, Teams or email; the structured result is there for writing your own version. Leave out room_code for the team's most recent finished room. Use this for "write up today's Fun Friday for the team channel". It only reads — post it with your own messaging tools.

room_code.description: The six-character room code for the session, e.g. "K7PQ2M". Case-insensitive. Room codes never contain the letters I or O, or the digits 0 or 1. Optional: leave it out for the most recent finished room.

name: funfriday_get_recap

all_time_top.description: The top three on the team's all-time leaderboard; empty for a room with no team.

winners.description: More than one when the top place was tied.

next_game.description: The caller's next planned game, if they have one.

played_on.description: The date the room was opened, YYYY-MM-DD.

standings.description: The room's overall table across every game played in it.

title: Recap a Fun Friday
